purpose.zh: 用髋部发力练臀部和大腿后侧的爆发力
purpose.en: Build explosive glute and hamstring power by driving with your hips.

text.zh: 髋部猛地往前推，让手臂把壶铃荡起来
text.en: Snap your hips forward and let your arm float the bell up

text.zh: 背保持平直，臀部往后推，壶铃荡到两腿之间。
text.en: Keep your back flat and push your hips back as the bell swings between your legs.

text.zh: 顶端站直夹臀，身体不后仰。
text.en: Stand tall at the top with glutes tight, without leaning back.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the bell with your arm.
Squatting instead of pushing the hips back.

cautions.zh: 腰疼时停止，先用轻壶铃
cautions.en: Stop if your lower back hurts, and start with a light bell.

cautions.zh: 周围有人或东西时不要做
cautions.en: Do not swing with people or objects nearby.

changes: 结束口令「折髋回摆」按 0.7 s 缩为「回摆」，英文去掉 Hinge
常见错误「折髋」改口语；caution 拆成两条「X 时 Y」
flags: 顶端「停留」0.8 s 其实是壶铃荡到最高的惯性停顿，按规则记为 rep_hold；如更想要 rep_updown 请定
